title: Dynamic Hub-and-Spoke Memory for Streaming Video Understanding
title_zh: 用于流式视频理解的动态中心—辐射式记忆
abstract_en: Streaming video understanding requires answering questions at arbitrary times over a continuously growing visual stream. The central challenge is to compactly remember long-range history while effectively retrieving question-relevant evidence. We propose Dynamic Hub-and-Spoke Memory (D-HSM), a training-free framework that represents distant history as structured textual memory while preserving the recent frames as visual tokens for fine-grained perception. Specifically, D-HSM turns selected historical video chunks into typed textual observations and stores them in an entity-centered hub-and-spoke memory, with entities as hubs and related evidence as spokes. When answering a question, D-HSM dynamically retrieves a compact question-aware memory subset, expands it through hub-and-spoke links, and combines it with the recent visual window for frozen-VLM answer prediction. Extensive experiments on both streaming and long video benchmarks show that D-HSM consistently and substantially improves VLM backbones and outperforms other state-of-the-art online and offline video understanding baselines.
abstract_zh: 流式视频理解要求系统能够在持续增长的视觉流中，于任意时刻回答问题。其核心挑战在于：既要紧凑地记忆长时历史，又要有效检索与问题相关的证据。本文提出无需训练的 Dynamic Hub-and-Spoke Memory（D-HSM）框架：将远距离历史表示为结构化文本记忆，同时保留近期帧的视觉 token，以支持细粒度感知。具体而言，D-HSM 将选定的历史视频片段转换为带类型的文本观察结果，并以实体为中心构建 hub-and-spoke 记忆结构，其中实体作为 hubs，相关证据作为 spokes。回答问题时，D-HSM 动态检索紧凑且面向问题的记忆子集，通过 hub-and-spoke 链接扩展相关信息，再将其与近期视觉窗口结合，交由冻结的 VLM 预测答案。在流式视频和长视频基准上的大量实验表明，D-HSM 能够稳定且显著地提升多种 VLM backbone 的性能，并优于其他先进的在线与离线视频理解基线。
key_points_zh: 提出无需训练的 Dynamic Hub-and-Spoke Memory（D-HSM），面向持续增长的视频流进行长时记忆与问答。
将历史视频片段转化为带类型的文本观察，并构建以实体为 hubs、证据为 spokes 的结构化记忆。
根据当前问题动态检索并扩展相关记忆，同时保留近期帧视觉 token，以兼顾长程语义与细粒度感知。
D-HSM 可直接增强冻结的 VLM backbone，在流式视频和长视频基准上显著优于现有在线及离线方法。
论文发表于 Findings of EMNLP 2026，研究方向为计算机视觉（cs.CV）。

llm_assessment.comment: A strong streaming-video memory contribution that improves long-horizon visual evidence retrieval, although it lacks an explicit tool-using or closed-loop agent interaction.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 该工作有效解决了流式视频中的长期视觉证据检索问题，但缺乏明确的工具调用或闭环智能体交互。
